= Wargames 5.0 Package =

Currently you can download the latest beta of the Wargames mod here:

* {{Link|http://ofpc.de/wargames/download.php|OFP WarGames MOD - Downloads by hx3}}
* {{Link|http://ofpc.de/wargames/e107_plugins/forum/forum_viewforum.php?15|Additional WGL Files (optional)}}
* {{Link|http://ofpc.de/wargames/e107_plugins/forum/forum_viewforum.php?16|Browse changelog forum}}

'''IMPORTANT'''

Either use '''right mouse button click: save as''' or some download manager like {{Link|http://www.freedownloadmanager.org|Free Download Manager}}.



= Package Information =

# While the .RAR package itself is currently roughly 160 MB, uncompressed the mod is around 363 MB, so make sure you have enough disc space available.
# The files of the mod are compressed in a .rar file to reduce the download size. Get the latest version of {{Link|http://www.7-zip.org|7-Zip}} to be able to unpack it.
